تستعرضن (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِضْنَ (tastaʕriḍna) /tas.taʕ.ridˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# تُسْتَعْرَضْنَ (tustaʕraḍna) /tus.taʕ.radˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
